workspace.name: Taipei Main · Zhongshan, 19 Dec 2025
workspace.description: Retrospective case study built only from published official records. No original CCTV was obtained; nothing here is a model observation.

note: Excerpts are short quotations from the cited public documents (times and places only). Victim and suspect identities are deliberately omitted. Times keep their recorded precision: 'approx' marks the prosecutors' '許' (about); operations-log times are as logged.

places.name: Taipei Main · B1 below Exit M7
Hotel near Zhongshan Station (name withheld in source)

timeline.text: Arrived at the open area on B1 below Exit M7 and prepared
timeline.excerpt: 於同日下午4 時58 分許至捷運臺北車站M7 出口下方地下1 樓空曠處（捐血中心前）準備

timeline.text: The attack began on B1 below Exit M7, with smoke grenades thrown
timeline.excerpt: 自下午5 時22 分許起，……接續拋擲數顆煙霧彈

timeline.text: The control centre received a fire alarm and reviewed station camera footage
timeline.excerpt: 17:24 行控中心環控電腦收到火警警訊。……調閱DVR

timeline.text: Police, fire engines and ambulances began arriving
timeline.excerpt: 17:28 員警、消防車及救護車陸續抵達現場。

timeline.text: Trains ordered to pass Taipei Main on the Blue Line without stopping
timeline.excerpt: 17:32 行控中心通告列車於藍線台北車站過站不停。

timeline.text: Left through the Zhongshan underground mall, exit R2, and returned to the hotel
timeline.excerpt: 進入中山地下街，再自中山地下街R2 出口步出，於下午5 時39 分許返回千○旅館

timeline.text: The control centre told metro police it had matched the suspect's features and shared camera images
timeline.excerpt: 17時39分，行控中心通報捷警已比對到兇嫌特徵，並提供監視器畫面圖像給捷警勤務指揮中心

timeline.text: Smoke cleared; trains resumed stopping at Taipei Main on the Blue Line
timeline.excerpt: 17:42 行控中心與現場指揮官確認現場煙霧已消散，列車恢復停靠藍線台北車站

timeline.text: Smoke grenades thrown on the crossing in front of Zhongshan Station
timeline.excerpt: 下午6 時38 分許，至捷運中山站前行人穿越道上丟擲煙霧彈2 顆
下午6 時39 分許，進入誠品南西店1 樓店內

timeline.text: Metro police notified the control centre of the incident outside Zhongshan Station
timeline.excerpt: 18:41 捷警通知：中山站4 號出口外有人扔擲煙霧彈

timeline.text: Zhongshan exits 1 and 4 restricted to entry only
timeline.excerpt: 18:50 中山站1 號及4 號出口陸續管制旅客只進不出。

timeline.text: Cameras checked: smoke at street level outside exit 4; concourse and platforms normal
timeline.excerpt: 18:51 行控調閱DVR 影像確認為中山站4 號出口外(地面層)有煙霧，大廳月台狀況正常

coverage.text: No camera failed that day. One recorder on the route at B2 could show live images but not play them back; its disk had been damaged the night before.
coverage.excerpt: 當天並無任何一臺監視器故障，然而在臺北車站B2層兇嫌路徑上其中一部錄影主機磁區於事發前一晚受損，可以看到即時影像但無法回溯

coverage.text: The other three of four B2 recorders worked; cross-referencing covered every floor of the route without a break.
coverage.excerpt: 該站B2層區域設有四組NVR錄影主機，三組影像紀錄及回放功能皆正常運作，透過交叉比對追蹤兇嫌移動路徑，各樓層足跡全面涵蓋，沒有斷點

coverage.text: 41 fire detectors triggered across zones; Taipei Metro will now treat multi-zone fire alarms as a security incident.
coverage.excerpt: 考量本案有41組探測器跨區作動，未來只要發生「多區域火災警報」即視同危安事件處理

coverage.text: Investigators reviewed more than 3,000 cameras, according to a secondary news report of the press conference.
coverage.excerpt: 經調閱逾3000支監視器比對
